verdict.rationale: Copilot documents its own connectors feature, which links the assistant to a small fixed set of services, including third-party Google Drive and Gmail/Calendar/Contacts, on Copilot.com and mobile. Nothing shows a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps, and the documented connector list is short and closed. Missing for 10: a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps, a broad third-party connector catalog, documented add/install flow details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: Connectors allow you to link Copilot to other services so you can easily find, summarize, and act on information from these services.
Copilot can connect with the following consumer services: Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft Outlook.com (email, calendar, and contacts), Google Drive, Google Gmail, Calendar, Contacts
Copilot connectors are currently available on Copilot.com and on Copilot Mobile (iOS and Android)
